topic: regrip a worn tennis racket handle
core_question: How do you replace a tennis racket's worn-out grip? (secondary: How do I avoid overdraft fees on my checking account?)
answer_summary: Unwind and remove the old grip tape, clean the handle, then spiral-wrap a new overgrip or replacement grip from the base of the handle up, securing the end with the included tape.; after the topic shift: Set up low-balance text/email alerts through your bank's app, link a savings account for automatic overdraft transfers, or opt out of overdraft coverage entirely so transactions are simply declined instead of incurring a fee.
persona: skeptical and testy; texting quickly with typos here and there
